summary.root_cause_text: Payment provider calls to internal://payments-v1 time out, so the worker marks orders processed with no payment. This is ongoing. The underlying cause is unknown: either the provider is down or the configured URL is wrong.
recommended: Check the payment provider's status and confirm the correct payment_provider_url. Use set_config only once the correct value is known.
After payments work again, run reprocess_orders with all_unpaid. It never double-charges.
Restarting the worker will not help while the provider is failing.
Consider pausing order intake until payments work.
